summary: A Mississauga personal injury firm with over 50 years of combined experience is a strength, but broken links and no inline contact form appear to cost you free consultations.

findings.problem: The Bicycle Accidents button appears to point to /bicycle-accidets while the menu uses /bicycle-accidents, Brain Injuries appears to link to /fatality-cases-1, and the LinkedIn link appears to be malformed.
findings.cost: Injured clients who click for their type of case may land on an error or the wrong page.
findings.fix: Correct links for every case type.

findings.problem: Every contact prompt appears to go to /contact with no inline form, and the free consultation line appears with no phone number or form next to it.
findings.cost: A client who is ready to call has to hunt for a way to reach you.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form and click to call button on every page.

findings.problem: Testimonials appear to contain typos such as 'advise', 'straight forward' and 'I just to thank you', and article links appear to contain 'nbsp' leftovers.
findings.cost: Typos in client reviews and broken addresses make the firm look careless.
findings.fix: Proofread reviews and clean article links.

findings.problem: The testimonials appear signed only with initials, no case results appear, and the three lawyers.com badges appear to link to the same profile.
findings.cost: Injury clients choose by proof, and thin proof loses them to a firm that shows results.
findings.fix: Named reviews with consent, results and linked badges.

redesign: Correct links for every case type.
A short enquiry form and click to call button.
